svg.title: Synthetic hedge error dispersion versus turnover
svg.desc: Common-shock synthetic scenarios, grouped by execution costs. Points show measured pooled sample standard deviations, not forecasts.

g.text: Discounted net error sample SD (USD); turnover is mean hedge notional (USD). Axes shared across costs.
